description: This file defines the AzureAnthropicConfig class, extending AnthropicConfig to handle Azure-specific authentication and request transformation for the Anthropic language model integration within the litellm project.

classes.name: AzureAnthropicConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for Azure-specific Anthropic model setup, including environment validation and request transformation.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates and sets up Azure authentication headers, supporting API key and Azure AD token, and prepares headers for requests.

methods.name: transform_request
methods.description: Transforms the request data by removing unsupported parameters specific to Azure Anthropic.
